notes: Missing nutrient values remain unknown. Tr remains trace, never numeric zero.
USDA carbohydrate by difference includes dietary fiber. CoFID CHO is retained separately in original source units; it is not mixed into that aggregate.
Vitamin E mg and retinol-equivalent mcg are retained in source units, without assuming IU equivalence.
Raw animal foods are catalog references, not a safety endorsement. Grains, potato, sweet potato and pumpkin are selectable only prepared.
No raw-to-boiled retention factors or cross-food substitutions.
Provider-calculated cooking profiles are imported as published (BLS, Matvaretabellen); they are not laboratory claims and are not locally estimated from raw ingredients.
BLS available CHO, Norwegian CHO remain in source data, separate from USDA carbohydrate-by-difference. BLS B6/copper/manganese micrograms are normalized explicitly.
PhilFCT F172/F175 have limited published composition. Unreported nutrients remain unknown, including potassium, magnesium, zinc and selenium.
Distinct cucumber entry prevent substituting whole/generic food for peeled cucumber.
FAO WAFCT records were found but are not included: the source requires permission for commercial reuse. Research evidence is retained separately.
Raw/dry grain, pumpkin, peeled potato and peeled sweet potato compositions are reference data. Existing cooked-only feeding selection restrictions are preserved.

The internal legacy preparation key boiled groups eligible moist-heat preparations. New braised profiles carry cookingMethod=braised; labels say Cooked and the exact method is shown. Roasted, grilled and fried preparations have not been added.
When a preparation has no published compatible record, the food information view identifies and shows an available raw reference instead; it never substitutes that composition into a cooked recipe.

Banana is excluded from new ingredient selection by owner instruction; historical records remain intact. No Saba profile is added. Ostrich is one food group as approved by the owner; raw minced-meat source and cooked leg-muscle source retain their exact descriptions. The cooked study profile has four published proximates and two explicitly labelled calculated estimates.

Elk FDC 168057 and pheasant FDC 169903 are published Cooked profiles with unspecified cooking method. The internal legacy preparation key boiled is displayed as Cooked; these are not claimed to be boiled measurements. Historical reference-only objects remain intact.
Cooked pheasant uses the total edible portion name, not the raw skinless-meat label. Existing raw data and saved snapshots are unchanged.
New ingredient selection shows only usable preparations: cooked-only grains, pumpkin, potato and sweet potato do not appear as disabled Raw choices. Their raw reference data remains intact.

By owner instruction, both peeled and generic cucumber are Raw-only choices, like duck liver, cantaloupe and watermelon. Existing cooked cucumber snapshots remain readable but are not offered as new choices.
